applies_why: The judge text gives a ground for an UNDERDETERMINED ruling that mentions the pressed verse, so K-S2 governs whether that ground is permissible.
quote: D6 vs C4 (Jeremiah 22:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: "That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED": I weighed (1) forbidding only express reliance on a single verse's failure to state a link or contrary and (2) forbidding any UNDERDETERMINED ruling involving a single pressed verse.
why: The judge's reason is the prior dropping of the curse limb and the absence of a live link to contradict, not that a single verse fails to state the link or its contrary.
